info.title: JARVIS task dispatch to existing GitHub workflow
info.description: Import candidate for a Copilot Studio REST tool. This schema does NOT enable GitHub Actions, grant API access or establish a connection. Requires secured per-user or admin-reviewed authentication and explicit approval.

post.summary: Request an explicitly approved JARVIS task
post.description: Creates a GitHub repository_dispatch event (jarvis-run). HTTP 204 only acknowledges event acceptance. Existing workflow is gated by JARVIS_REPOSITORY_DISPATCH_ENABLED and must remain disabled until reviewed. Do not call automatically or with confidential content.

event_type.description: Must match the existing workflow's repository_dispatch trigger.

task.description: Explicitly approved task, without secrets or sensitive personal data.

tier.description: Choose FREE for first approved smoke test. FREE does not guarantee zero external cost.

request_id.description: Optional UUID for tracing. Do not include end-user identifiers.

safeTest.summary: Synthetic dry-run-style request (only after explicit approval)

client_payload.task: Sammanfatta tre offentliga punkter om systemets arkitektur utan externa utskick.

204.description: GitHub accepted the dispatch request; does not prove that JARVIS ran.

403.description: Insufficient repository permissions or policy restriction.

404.description: Repository not accessible to the authenticated account.

GitHubBearer.description: Configure through a secure connection in Copilot Studio/Power Platform. Never paste credentials into this file, prompts, chat messages or source control. Restrict to this repository.
